svg.title: Barcode Bill Scanner App - Complete User Flow
svg.desc: Step-by-step workflow from app launch through bill creation, barcode scanning, and PDF export

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about the home screen')
g.text: List of saved bills + Create Bill button
Product Name field active, others locked

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens after entering product name?')
sendPrompt('How are serial number tabs created?')
g.text: Enter Quantity → Serial Number Tabs Appear

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the serial number entry options?')
g.text: Manual entry OR scan barcode (camera icon)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does manual serial entry work?')
sendPrompt('What happens when I tap the camera icon?')
sendPrompt('What happens if barcode scanning fails?')
sendPrompt('What happens after all serials are filled?')
sendPrompt('What happens when I click save?')
sendPrompt('What does the PDF preview show?')
g.text: Download, Back to Edit, Share, Print buttons
